candidates.change_summary: Deploy the oracle with address(0) as owner instead of msg.sender, so the new oracle's owner() observable on the new contract differs.
Delete the emit statement so the NewEmergencyOracle event is no longer emitted.
Remove the onlyAdmin modifier so non-admin callers can create oracles, changing revert behavior of the call.
Invert the admin check so that only non-admins can pass the modifier.
